name: RealTrace AI – Real Human and AI Traffic Counter
author: adnan.limdi

sections.description:
RealTrace AI provides real-time, privacy-first analytics for WordPress. It tracks incoming visitors through a dual-layer approach (server-side capture and client-side non-blocking REST beacons) to distinguish real humans from AI crawlers, search engine indexers, and automated scraping tools.

Unlike standard visitor counters that treat every automated HTTP hit as a genuine person, RealTrace AI filters and segments incoming traffic into three distinct tiers: Humans, AI & LLM Crawlers, and Search Engine Bots.

Bots & Crawlers Detected Out-of-the-Box

RealTrace AI evaluates request patterns, URI endpoints, and User-Agent headers against extensive internal signatures:

1. AI & LLM Crawlers

  • OpenAI: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot
  • Anthropic: ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Anthropic-AI
  • Google AI: Google-Extended, Gemini, Gemini Deep Research
  • Perplexity: PerplexityBot, Perplexity-AI
  • Meta: Meta-ExternalAgent, Meta-ExternalFetcher, FacebookExternalHit
  • xAI: GrokBot, xAI-Crawler
  • ByteDance: ByteSpider
  • DeepSeek: DeepSeek Bot, DeepSeek Web Crawler
  • Apple: Applebot-Extended (Apple Intelligence)
  • Mistral AI: MistralAI Crawler
  • Cohere: Cohere-AI
  • Amazon: AmazonBot
  • AI Datasets & Aggregators: Common Crawl (CCBot), Diffbot, You.com (YouBot), DuckAssistBot, Allen AI (AI2Bot), Webz.io / Omgili, ImageSift, Timpi, Katerat, SentientMachine, Pango

2. Search Engine Indexers

  • Googlebot, Google Asset Service, Google Inspection Tool
  • Bingbot, Applebot, Baidu Spider, YandexBot / Yandex Engine
  • DuckDuckBot, Sogou Spider, Exabot, Qwantify, SeznamBot, PetalBot, CocCoc Bot
  • Moz DotBot, AhrefsBot, SemrushBot, Majestic MJ12bot

3. Social Previews & Uptime Monitors

  • TwitterBot / X, LinkedInBot, WhatsApp Preview, TelegramBot, Slackbot, DiscordBot, Pinterest Bot
  • UptimeRobot, Pingdom, Site24x7, StatusCake, Screaming Frog SEO Spider, Seltz Sitemap Fetcher

4. Developer Tools & Headless Scrapers

  • Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium, Headless Chrome, PhantomJS, Cypress
  • Python (Requests, urllib, aiohttp), Scrapy Framework
  • cURL, Wget, HTTPie, Postman Runtime, Insomnia
  • Node.js (Axios, Fetch, Got), Go HTTP, Java HTTP Client, Apache HttpClient, OkHttp, Guzzle PHP, Perl libwww, WinHTTP

5. Automated Endpoint Scrapers

  • Flags unauthenticated direct automated scrapes targeting sensitive or automated endpoints like /wp-json/oembed/, /.well-known/, /feed, /rss, /wp-cron.php, /xmlrpc.php, and /wp-comments-post.php.

Included Shortcodes

  • [realtrace_smart_counter] – Displays a complete visitor card showing total humans, bots, and the verified Human Score percentage.
  • [realtrace_traffic_battle] – Displays an interactive split progress bar comparing human visitors against AI scrapers.
  • [realtrace_human_counter] – Outputs the raw formatted count of verified human visitors.
  • [realtrace_ai_counter] – Outputs the raw formatted count of detected bots and AI scrapers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the realtrace-traffic-counter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugin search.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure the MaxMind reader library is located in includes/Geo/MaxMind/.
  4. Go to RealTrace AI > Settings and click Download / Update Geo Database to stream and verify the offline binary database (.mmdb).
  5. Use the shortcodes in posts, page templates, block editors, or widget areas.
sections.faq:
Does RealTrace AI send visitor IP addresses to external lookup APIs?

No. RealTrace AI resolves countries using an offline MaxMind binary database stored locally in your wp-content/uploads/realtrace/ folder. Visitor IPs are processed entirely on your server.

What happens if the Geo database is missing or corrupt?

RealTrace AI includes built-in verification. If the .mmdb file is missing or interrupted during transfer, the plugin falls back to its multi-octet subnet router, purges any broken files, and presents a one-click download button in the admin interface.

Can I add custom bot signatures?

Yes. In RealTrace AI > Settings, enter custom substrings under Custom Bot Signatures (one signature per line). Any User-Agent matching that text will be classified as an AI bot.

Does tracking slow down page requests?

No. Geolocation queries run against an optimized local binary search tree in microseconds, and a built-in visit debounce window prevents repeat hits from the same IP from inflating database load.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Database Fix: Resolved SQLite compatibility error in 7-day trend queries by passing date boundaries directly from PHP, ensuring compatibility with standard MySQL, MariaDB, and SQLite (WordPress Playground).
  • Fix: Resolved PHP 8+ fatal error during plugin activation by eliminating non-static method calls within static activation routines.
  • Database Schema: Corrected strict formatting in dbDelta schema definition to guarantee clean creation of the country_code column and indexes on fresh installs.
  • Stability: Added WordPress Playground/WASM detection to prevent sandbox download timeouts and false corrupted database alerts.
  • Accuracy: Reclassified Slackbot and social media preview crawlers under the Other Bot category instead of Human.

1.1.1

  • Feature: Added native CSV and JSON log export with active category filter support.
  • Security & Accuracy: Patched REST probe loophole—direct automated hits to /wp-json/ routes are now correctly flagged as automated scrapers instead of human visits.
  • Fix: Excluded internal tracking endpoints from server-side hit logging to eliminate self-ping loops.

1.1.1

  • Feature: Added native CSV and JSON log export with active category filter support.
  • Security & Accuracy: Patched REST probe loophole—direct automated hits to /wp-json/ routes are now correctly flagged as automated scrapers instead of human visits.
  • Fix: Excluded internal tracking endpoints from server-side hit logging to eliminate self-ping loops.

1.1.0

  • Feature: Added native offline binary geolocation using MaxMind .mmdb reader support.
  • Feature: Added an asynchronous admin REST API endpoint (realtrace/v1/update-geo-db) for downloading and verifying the Geo database.
  • Feature: Added binary integrity validation (\xab\xcd\xefMaxMind.com) to detect and purge truncated or incomplete downloads.
  • Feature: Integrated dashboard warning and error notices when the local database is missing or corrupt.
  • Design: Complete UI redesign of the Settings screen with a brand-aligned layout, status badges, and single-screen feedback banners.
  • Improvement: Expanded the offline multi-octet fallback subnet router for Middle East and European IP blocks.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
